image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a white ceramic bowl containing fresh figs. One whole green fig with brown speckles sits in the upper left. In the foreground, a fig is cut in half, revealing orange-pink flesh and seeds. To the right, there are pieces of pale, translucent fruit or vegetable skin/flesh, possibly from another fig or a different ingredient like onion or garlic, though they appear somewhat irregular.
